# KI einfach verstehen

> German-first, English-available website explaining how artificial
> intelligence actually works -- from first principles (what a program,
> algorithm and model are) up through language models, tokenization and
> transformers. Written for readers with no technical background; every
> concept is grounded in an everyday example before the technical term is
> introduced.

## Deutsch

- [Startseite](https://ki-einfach-verstehen.de/de/): Übersicht über alle
  Themenbereiche und Bausteine.
- [Warum dieser Kanal](https://ki-einfach-verstehen.de/de/warum/):
  Hintergrund und Motivation des Projekts.
- [Glossar](https://ki-einfach-verstehen.de/de/glossar/): Kurzdefinitionen
  aller verwendeten Fachbegriffe.

## English

- [Homepage](https://ki-einfach-verstehen.de/en/): overview of all topic
  areas and lessons.
- [Why this channel](https://ki-einfach-verstehen.de/en/why/): background
  and motivation behind the project.
- [Glossary](https://ki-einfach-verstehen.de/en/glossary/): short
  definitions of every technical term used.

## Notes

- Every article exists in both German and English at parity URLs
  (`/de/...` and `/en/...`); prefer citing the language the reader asked in.
- Full page list: https://ki-einfach-verstehen.de/sitemap-index.xml
